analysis.location_and_population: Lineages IV and V have been recorded in wild rodents within the Caucasus and Spain, while the divergent Dandenong virus was detected during an Australian transplant cluster.
analysis.event: Seroepidemiologic studies have also recorded exposure in pregnant cohorts in Philadelphia, where IgG seropositivity reached 2.4 to 2.7 percent, alongside seropositivity reaching 13 percent in Austrian zoo workers, 36 percent in Croatian rodents, and 37.5 percent in Slovakian rodents.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: A comprehensive clinical review by Pencole and colleagues evaluating sixty-eight congenital cases demonstrated that manifestations are dominated by chorioretinitis in 84 percent of cases, hydrocephalus in 53 percent, microcephaly in 31 percent, ventriculomegaly in 16 percent, and periventricular calcifications in 16 percent.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: Because therapeutic measures remain restricted, public health strategies emphasize primary prevention through comprehensive rodent control programs, safe disposal of household infestations using wet cleaning techniques to suppress airborne aerosols, and the utilization of personal protective equipment.
